geek.significado: The term used for big fans of Japanese pop culture, especially anime (animation) and manga (comics).
geek.exemplo_correto: He's such an otaku that he has watched every episode of Naruto three times.
exemplos_incorretos: The fisherman gave the line a firm otaku before casting the net.
My boss is a real otaku, he reviews every detail of the report three times.
He's an otaku of old stamps, he has a huge collection stored at home.
significados_incorretos: A type of knot used to secure fishing nets.
An extremely organized and perfectionist person at work.
Japanese synonym for a collector of any kind of object, unrelated to anime.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a fan identity without judgment, simply indicating a strong interest in Japanese pop culture.

geek.significado: A fictional female character (usually from anime or games) that a fan deeply admires or feels a platonic romantic attraction to.
geek.exemplo_correto: Hinata is the waifu of many fans who follow the anime.
exemplos_incorretos: I learned to make a paper waifu in art class.
The anime's waifu only showed up in the last episode to defeat the hero.
Goku has been his favorite waifu since childhood.
significados_incorretos: A very complex origami folding technique.
A villain character who only appears at the end of an anime.
Any anime character the fan likes the most, whether male or female.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it names a fan's preference for a fictional character, without implying harm or merit for whoever uses the term.

geek.significado: A term used to define something that officially belongs to the original story of a work, validated by its creator.
geek.exemplo_correto: That event in the comic is canon, meaning it's part of the official timeline.
exemplos_incorretos: I used canon thread to fix the hem of my pants.
It's just a fan theory, it hasn't become canon officially yet.
It appeared in a special edition, so it's already canon, even if the publisher denies it later.
significados_incorretos: A type of thread used to sew thick clothes.
A fan theory about what may happen in the next season.
Anything that appears in the comics, even if it is later disproved.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it is a technical term in fan culture for validating what is official in a work, with no emotional weight.

geek.significado: An episode or story arc created only to fill space in a series, which doesn't advance the main plot.
geek.exemplo_correto: You can skip the third season of the anime, it's almost entirely made up of filler episodes.
exemplos_incorretos: I replaced the door filler because it was sticking.
This filler episode showed never-before-seen dubbing behind-the-scenes footage.
This episode was a bit weak, it must be filler, even though it reveals the villain's past.
significados_incorretos: A type of lock used on security doors.
A special episode with never-before-seen scenes of the cast.
Any weaker episode of a season, even if it advances the story.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes content seen as padding, which slows down the plot and frustrates those who want to follow the main story.

geek.significado: An early reveal of important details of a movie, series or book's story, ruining the surprise for those who haven't seen it yet.
geek.exemplo_correto: Don't tell me who dies at the end of the movie, I hate getting spoilers!
exemplos_incorretos: The conductor played a low spoiler at the gala performance.
The studio dropped an official spoiler in the trailer before the premiere.
He said he liked the movie, and that's already a spoiler for me.
significados_incorretos: A wind instrument used in orchestras.
An official summary released by the studio itself before the release.
Any comment about a movie, even without revealing plot details.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it refers to ruining someone else's surprise, which is considered inconsiderate among fans.

geek.significado: The art of dressing up as and portraying a famous character from anime, comics, movies or video games.
geek.exemplo_correto: The geek event was packed with people doing cosplay as superheroes.
exemplos_incorretos: The plumber did a cosplay on the bathroom pipes.
I bought a ready-made cosplay at the store, without having to sew anything.
I went to the party in a generic witch costume, kind of like a cosplay.
significados_incorretos: A plumbing technique for replacing old pipes.
A piece of clothing sold ready-made, without any handmade production.
Wearing any costume, even if it isn't of a specific character.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it celebrates the creativity, dedication and artistic skill of those who dress up as and portray characters.

geek.significado: A secret reference, joke or message hidden by creators inside a game, movie or website for fans to discover.
geek.exemplo_correto: Did you see that Captain America shield easter egg hidden in the movie scene?
exemplos_incorretos: I whipped the egg whites with the easter egg until stiff peaks formed.
The producers released an official easter egg showing the alternate ending.
I saw a funny camera mistake in the background of the scene, it must be an easter egg.
significados_incorretos: A kitchen utensil used to whip egg whites.
An official alternate ending released by the movie's producers.
Any funny detail that appears by accident in a scene.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it describes a fun and rewarding detail, designed to bring joy to whoever discovers it.

geek.significado: A shocking and unexpected turn in a story's script, completely changing the course of things.
geek.exemplo_correto: The villain was the hero's best friend all along. What an absurd plot twist!
exemplos_incorretos: The scout taught a plot twist to secure the tent.
The car chase was an incredible plot twist, full of adrenaline.
I was very sad about that scene, it was a huge plot twist.
significados_incorretos: A knot used by scouts to tie down tents.
Any exciting action scene in the middle of a movie.
A sad scene that changes the audience's mood, even without a real surprise.
geek.impacto_motivo: Depends on context because it can be praised when well executed (positively surprising) or criticized when it feels forced or poorly built.

geek.significado: A meeting of characters, settings or universes from different stories in a single special work.
geek.exemplo_correto: The Avengers is the biggest superhero crossover in movie history.
exemplos_incorretos: These sneakers have a reinforced crossover on the sole.
The movie did a crossover just by mentioning the other hero's name.
The movie's sequel is a crossover, because it continues the same story.
significados_incorretos: A type of sole used in running shoes.
A quick mention of another movie, without the characters actually appearing.
Any sequel to a movie that continues the previous story.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it celebrates the creativity of uniting different universes in a special way for fans.

geek.significado: A term from Star Wars for an apprentice. Used in real life to refer to someone new in some field.
geek.exemplo_correto: You still have a lot to learn about programming, my young padawan.
exemplos_incorretos: I used the padawan to trim the grass in the yard.
The padawan betrayed the master and became the main villain of the movie.
He's a young character in the movie, he must be a padawan.
significados_incorretos: A gardening tool for cutting tall grass.
A villain who betrays his master in the middle of the story.
Any young character in a science fiction movie.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it values the learning and growth of those who are just starting out in a field, without a pejorative tone.

geek.significado: A novice person, with no experience or little skill in a game or technology.
geek.exemplo_correto: He died in the very first minute of the match, he played like a real noob.
exemplos_incorretos: The noob was missing from the shelf assembly box.
He pretends to be a noob just so others let their guard down in the match.
I've never played this map before, that's probably why I play like a noob today.
significados_incorretos: A type of screw used in furniture assembly.
An experienced player who pretends not to know how to play to provoke others.
Anyone who is playing a specific match for the first time.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it is used in a derogatory way to point out someone's lack of skill or experience.

geek.significado: A delay in network communication, causing the game or stream to freeze or respond slowly.
geek.exemplo_correto: I only lost the fight in the game because my internet had a lot of lag.
exemplos_incorretos: I put a little lag in the recipe to add flavor.
My internet went down completely, there was a total lag and everything froze.
The website took a while to load, it must have lagged.
significados_incorretos: A spice used in Scandinavian cooking.
A total connection drop, when the internet goes down completely.
Any delay in loading an internet page.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes a technical problem that ruins the gaming or streaming experience.

geek.significado: An error or programming flaw in a game, app or system that makes something work in a strange way.
geek.exemplo_correto: My character got stuck in the game's wall because of a bug.
exemplos_incorretos: He wore an elegant bug to the wedding.
The company released a new bug to improve the game's graphics.
That strange effect on the screen must be a bug, even though it's a special effect.
significados_incorretos: A type of tie worn with formal attire.
An official update released by the company for the game.
Anything strange that happens in the game, even if it's intentional.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it names a flaw that compromises the correct functioning of a system or app.

geek.significado: To raise the level of a character in a game or improve a piece of equipment.
geek.exemplo_correto: I spent the entire weekend playing to level up my hero to the max level.
exemplos_incorretos: I went to the barbershop to level up my hair really short.
I bought a new skin at the store, I spent real money to level up my character.
I got an extra coin on the mission, I think I leveled up a bit.
significados_incorretos: Cutting hair very short, like a military cut.
Buying a new item in the game store with real money.
Getting any reward in the game, even without changing level.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it describes evolution, progress and achievement within a game.

geek.significado: Performing repetitive tasks in a game with the goal of accumulating lots of money, experience points or specific items.
geek.exemplo_correto: I'm going to farm these weak creatures for an hour to get enough gold for the sword.
exemplos_incorretos: I called the plumber to farm the leaking pipe under the sink.
Instead of playing, he paid real money to farm the items straight from the store.
I did this mission only once, but I already consider that I farmed the item.
significados_incorretos: Fixing a water leak at home.
Buying game items with real money instead of playing to get them.
Doing any game mission, even if only once.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a common and strategic practice in games, without judgment about who does it.

geek.significado: Rewards, items or treasures that drop from defeated enemies or are found in chests in games.
geek.exemplo_correto: We defeated the boss and the loot was amazing, we got a legendary armor.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought new loot to run the marathon.
I used the loot, which is the game's currency, to buy armor at the store.
I bought this sword at the game store, so it became my loot.
significados_incorretos: A type of shoe used in street races.
The game's official currency used to buy items in the store.
Any item the player buys, even without defeating enemies.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it describes rewards and achievements that bring satisfaction to the player.

geek.significado: The act of an enemy in the game dropping an item when defeated, or the probability of a rare item dropping.
geek.exemplo_correto: The drop chance of this rare sword is only 1%, we'll have to try many times.
exemplos_incorretos: He pulled off an incredible drop on the dance floor.
I finished the tutorial and got a guaranteed welcome drop.
I bought this weapon at the store, but I consider it a lucky drop.
significados_incorretos: A dance move used at electronic parties.
An item the player gets automatically when completing the tutorial.
Any game reward, even if bought in the official store.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it is associated with the thrill of getting a desired item in the game.

geek.significado: The place or the act of being reborn in the game after the character or an enemy has been killed.
geek.exemplo_correto: I waited at the respawn point until my character came back into the match.
exemplos_incorretos: The respawn chair at the movie theater reclines all the way back.
The game did an automatic respawn saving my progress right there.
My character stood still for a second and started walking again, it was a quick respawn.
significados_incorretos: A type of reclining seat used in movie theaters.
The moment when the game automatically saves progress.
Any time the character starts moving again after standing still.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a standard game mechanic, without implying judgment about the player.

geek.significado: A temporary improvement to a character's attributes (such as strength or defense) given by a spell, or a permanent improvement made by the game's creators.
geek.exemplo_correto: The mage cast a buff spell and now our whole team deals double damage.
exemplos_incorretos: The buff glass on the window is impact-resistant.
I picked up an extremely rare item that only appears once, it was a huge buff.
I got a permanent advantage in the game, that counts as a buff too.
significados_incorretos: A type of glass used in bulletproof windows.
A rare item that only appears once per match.
Any advantage the player gets, even if it isn't temporary.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it describes an improvement that strengthens the character, benefiting whoever receives it.

geek.significado: When a game's developers reduce the power of a character or weapon because it was too strong and unbalancing the game.
geek.exemplo_correto: They nerfed my favorite class and now it's impossible to win matches.
exemplos_incorretos: I used nerf to stick the school poster on the wall.
They removed the character from the game entirely, it was more than a nerf, it was a ban.
A new update came out, it must have changed something, it was a nerf.
significados_incorretos: A type of glue used in school craft projects.
When the game completely removes a character for being unfair.
Any change developers make in a game update.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it implies the loss of strength of something the player liked, and is usually received as bad news by the community.

geek.significado: Acronym for 'Non-Playable Character'. Game characters controlled by the computer, usually to give quests or sell items.
geek.exemplo_correto: I talked to the town NPC to start the next part of the game's story.
exemplos_incorretos: I need to replace the hex NPC from the shelf that fell.
I control the main NPC of the story, making his decisions.
That character only appeared twice, he must be an unimportant NPC.
significados_incorretos: A type of hex screw used in industrial assembly.
The main character controlled by the player in the story.
Any secondary character who appears in few scenes of the game.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it is a technical term for classifying characters controlled by the game, with no value judgment.

geek.significado: The 'big boss' at the end of a level or of the entire game, an enemy much stronger and harder to defeat than normal ones.
geek.exemplo_correto: I spent three hours trying and finally managed to defeat the game's final boss.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought boss fabric to make the living room curtain.
I killed like five identical bosses just in this starting level.
Right at the first level a very strong enemy appeared, it must be the boss.
significados_incorretos: A type of fabric used in heavy curtains.
Any regular enemy that appears several times in the level.
The strongest character who appears right at the start of the game.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it merely describes a type of challenge within the game, without judgment about the player.

geek.significado: A player in shooter games who stays hidden in a single strategic spot waiting for the enemy to pass by in order to shoot, without moving around the map.
geek.exemplo_correto: That camper stayed hidden behind the door the whole match just waiting for us to walk by.
exemplos_incorretos: I used a new camper to wash the dishes after lunch.
That camper never stops, he runs the entire map without rest.
He stood still for a few seconds reloading his weapon, he must be a camper.
significados_incorretos: A type of sponge used to wash dishes.
A player who runs around the entire map without stopping anywhere.
Any player who stands still for a few seconds during the match.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it is used critically to point out a strategy considered cowardly or unsportsmanlike in the game.

geek.significado: To attack the enemy quickly in an aggressive and direct way, without giving them time to prepare, or to advance quickly through the game ignoring side quests.
geek.exemplo_correto: Let's all rush the enemy base together now while they're distracted!
exemplos_incorretos: I rushed the cream on my face before going to sleep.
Let's rush this map nice and slowly, picking up everything we find.
We attacked calmly and carefully, but it was still a rush.
significados_incorretos: Applying a moisturizing cream to the skin after a shower.
Exploring the map slowly, collecting every possible item.
Any attack made in the game, even if slow and cautious.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes an aggressive play style, which can be praised or criticized depending on the situation, but the term itself is merely descriptive.

geek.significado: A precise shot to the enemy's head in shooter games, which usually eliminates the target instantly and requires a lot of skill.
geek.exemplo_correto: I managed to land a headshot from very far away using the sniper rifle.
exemplos_incorretos: I got a new headshot at the salon for the wedding.
I hit him in the arm, that was a real headshot.
I hit him right in the chest and he dropped instantly, it must have been a headshot.
significados_incorretos: A type of hairstyle done at beauty salons.
Any shot that hits the enemy, wherever it lands.
A precise shot to the enemy's chest that also eliminates instantly.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it celebrates a precise shot that requires great skill from the player.

geek.significado: Magical energy that a character has in RPG games, needed to cast spells and use special abilities. When it runs out, you can't cast spells.
geek.exemplo_correto: My mana ran out, I need to drink a blue potion before casting another spell.
exemplos_incorretos: The mana blew strongly at the beach this morning.
My mana hit zero and my character died instantly.
My energy bar ran out, I think I ran out of mana, even though it was the health one.
significados_incorretos: A type of strong wind common on the coast of northeastern Brazil.
The character's health, which when it runs out, he dies in the game.
Any character energy bar, including health.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it is a technical term from RPG games, with no value judgment attached.

geek.significado: Slang for the attention of the game-controlled enemy. 'Pulling aggro' means making the monster attack you instead of your weakest ally.
geek.exemplo_correto: Since you're the heavy-armored knight, pull the dragon's aggro so I can heal the team.
exemplos_incorretos: The mason used aggro to grout the tiles.
My character caused a lot of damage aggro in this fight.
The monster appeared next to me, I think I already pulled its aggro.
significados_incorretos: A type of mortar used in construction work.
The total damage a character deals during the match.
Any moment when the enemy appears near the player.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a game mechanic, without judgment about who uses it.

geek.significado: A bizarre, temporary flaw in the game that causes strange visual effects, like flickering textures, or breaks the scenery's physics without necessarily ruining progress.
geek.exemplo_correto: A funny glitch happened and the game's walls started becoming transparent.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a new glitch to tie my hair up.
The developer released a security glitch this week.
A really pretty light effect appeared on the screen, it must be an intentional glitch.
significados_incorretos: A type of bow used to tie hair up.
A security update released by the game's developer.
Any pretty visual effect that appears on purpose in the game.
geek.impacto_motivo: Depends on context because it can be seen as fun and curious by players, but also frustrating when it hinders progress in the game.

geek.significado: The challenge of trying to finish a game (or a level) in the shortest possible time, usually using advanced techniques and exploiting game flaws.
geek.exemplo_correto: He broke the world record doing a speedrun and beat Super Mario in under five minutes.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a speedrun raincoat so I wouldn't get wet.
He beat it on the hardest mode, with no hurry at all, it was quite a speedrun.
He beat the game really quickly without even knowing what he was doing, it must have been a speedrun.
significados_incorretos: A type of waterproof fabric used in raincoats.
Finishing the game on the hardest available mode, regardless of time.
Any player who finishes the game quickly, even without any technique.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it celebrates the skill and dedication of those who manage to complete the game quickly.

geek.significado: Combining materials and resources in a game to create new items, such as weapons, potions or armor.
geek.exemplo_correto: I collected enough wood and iron, now I'm heading to the workshop to craft a new sword.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a new craft for the weekend hike.
I bought the sword ready-made at the store, I didn't even have to craft anything.
I just combined two items in my backpack, I think I already crafted something.
significados_incorretos: A type of shoe used for hiking on trails.
Buying a ready-made item directly from the game store.
Any action of combining two items in the inventory, even without creating anything new.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a common item-creation mechanic within games.

geek.significado: Rooting for two characters or people to become a romantic couple in a story or in real life.
geek.exemplo_correto: I've shipped these two characters so much since the first season.
exemplos_incorretos: I need to ship this heavy box to the second floor.
They're already married in the official story, so the author keeps shipping.
I bought a new ship for my collectibles shelf.
significados_incorretos: Carrying or pushing a very heavy object.
The author's official action when confirming a marriage in the script.
A type of limited-edition collectible figure.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it expresses affectionate support and rooting for a fictional or real couple to end up together.

geek.significado: Intense anticipation, excitement or promotional buzz surrounding the release of a game, movie or product.
geek.exemplo_correto: The trailer for the new Spider-Man game created a gigantic hype in the community.
exemplos_incorretos: I washed the dishes with the hype I bought at the supermarket.
The movie was canceled before release because of excess hype.
I thought the movie was bad, so it was definitely made with a lot of hype.
significados_incorretos: A high-efficiency cleaning product.
A production error that leads to the cancellation of a project.
A synonym for a movie of low visual quality.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it expresses genuine excitement and positive anticipation for a release.

geek.significado: A community or group of fans dedicated to a specific franchise, series, game, band or fictional universe.
geek.exemplo_correto: The Harry Potter fandom remains very active even years after the books ended.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a chocolate fandom at the bakery.
He played alone offline the whole time to create his own fandom.
The publisher hired a fandom to draw the official cover.
significados_incorretos: A traditional confectionery sweet.
A single-player game mode with no internet access.
A professional illustrator hired by big publishers.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a community of fans, without value judgment about the group.

geek.significado: An action in multiplayer games (like MOBAs) where one or more players ambush an unsuspecting opponent with a numerical advantage.
geek.exemplo_correto: Our team's jungler came into my lane and pulled off a perfect gank to secure the kill.
exemplos_incorretos: I used gank to lubricate the bicycle gear.
The player challenged the opponent to a fair 1v1 duel and called it a gank.
I did a gank by buying potions at the game store.
significados_incorretos: A type of industrial lubricating oil.
A formal and balanced one-on-one confrontation between two players.
The act of acquiring consumable items in the virtual store.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a common tactic in multiplayer games, not necessarily indicating misconduct.

geek.significado: The act of abruptly disconnecting or closing a game out of anger when losing or suffering frustration.
geek.exemplo_correto: After conceding three goals in a row, he rage quit and turned off the console.
exemplos_incorretos: He rage quit to celebrate winning the championship.
The game saved my progress normally when I did the planned rage quit.
Rage quitting is an allowed strategy in tournaments to pause the match.
significados_incorretos: An enthusiastic celebration after winning a match.
Leaving the game calmly and on schedule after saving progress.
A tactical pause officially requested during professional matches.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes a reaction of anger and lack of emotional control in the face of frustration in the game.

geek.significado: A highly experienced player who creates a low-level secondary account to play against beginners and win easily.
geek.exemplo_correto: That level 5 player was playing like a pro, he's definitely a smurf.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a smurf at the market to season the salad.
He played on his own max-level main account and they called him a smurf.
The smurf is the official training mode provided by the developers.
significados_incorretos: A type of seasoning used in home cooking.
Using the oldest, most leveled-up main account in a match.
An automated training environment against bots in the game.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes a practice considered unfair, since the player takes advantage of others' disadvantage.

geek.significado: A player who tries extremely hard to win at all costs, even in casual matches or ones with no competitive value.
geek.exemplo_correto: It was just a friendly match to have fun, but there was a tryhard playing like it was a championship final.
exemplos_incorretos: The player left the match in the first minute because he's such a tryhard.
He played without paying attention while watching TV, a real tryhard.
Tryhard is the graphics configuration tool in the game's menus.
significados_incorretos: Someone who quits the game at the first obstacle.
An inattentive player who plays with no interest in the result.
A visual options menu to improve the game's performance.
geek.impacto_motivo: Depends on context because it can be praised as dedication in competitive matches, but criticized when excessive effort unbalances casual games.

geek.significado: An alternative look, outfit or aesthetic appearance for a character, weapon or item in a game, without changing its functional attributes.
geek.exemplo_correto: I bought a legendary Halloween skin for my favorite character in the game.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a new skin that increased my sword's damage by 50%.
The server went down because of a skin in the network connection.
I applied a skin to the wall to cover the dampness.
significados_incorretos: A paid item that changes attack power or combat attributes.
A critical infrastructure failure on a game's servers.
A type of waterproofing paint for construction.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it is associated with aesthetic customization and visual fun within the game.

geek.significado: A crucial moment when a player manages to win a decisive round alone against multiple opponents.
geek.exemplo_correto: He was left alone against three enemies and pulled off an incredible clutch to save the team.
exemplos_incorretos: The driver replaced the engine clutch before the road trip.
He lost the easy match in a clutch and the team was eliminated without reacting.
I pressed the clutch button to open the game store.
significados_incorretos: A mechanical part that makes up the transmission of motor vehicles.
A humiliating defeat against a single weak opponent.
A keyboard shortcut for buying items in the inventory.
geek.impacto_motivo: Positive because it celebrates a moment of heroic comeback and skill under pressure.

geek.significado: To lose emotional control or concentration after consecutive mistakes, starting to play in a disorganized and angry way.
geek.exemplo_correto: I missed two passes at the start of the game, tilted completely and started doing everything wrong.
exemplos_incorretos: I tilted the button on the keyboard to raise the music volume.
He was super calm and focused after tilting in the middle of the match.
I tilted the wall of the house to adjust the angle of the sun.
significados_incorretos: Pressing a physical key to control audio on the computer.
Entering a state of deep focus and mental calm.
Tilting a physical structure during construction work.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes a loss of emotional control that hurts the player's performance.

geek.significado: Waiting time required before an ability, spell or item can be used again in the game.
geek.exemplo_correto: I can't use the heal now, the ability is still on cooldown for five more seconds.
exemplos_incorretos: I turned on the cooldown to chill the water in the kitchen filter.
The game's cooldown lets you use the same spell endlessly without stopping.
I bought a new cooldown to use with my laptop.
significados_incorretos: A household appliance responsible for cooling liquids.
A feature that permanently eliminates spell waiting time.
A hardware accessory for cooling laptops.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a standard technical mechanism in games.

geek.significado: An invisible area in the game's code that determines the exact space where a character or object can take damage.
geek.exemplo_correto: This character's hitbox is huge, any shot hits him easily.
exemplos_incorretos: I stored my tools inside a plastic hitbox.

significados_incorretos: A physical storage box for workshop tools.
The system responsible for playing a game's soundtrack.
An input command used to change the equipped weapon.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it is a technical game programming term, with no value judgment.

geek.significado: A game where players who spend real money gain unfair performance advantages over those who play for free.
geek.exemplo_correto: This game became extremely pay to win; whoever buys the store items always wins.
exemplos_incorretos: This game is so pay to win that it's impossible to spend money on it.
A pay to win game is one that only sells cosmetic clothing.
He played a hundred hours for free without buying anything and was therefore called pay to win.
significados_incorretos: Games that have no kind of in-game store with real money.
Titles that exclusively sell aesthetic changes with no impact on gameplay.
A player who refuses to make purchases with real coins.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes a practice considered unfair, favoring those who pay over those who play for free.

geek.significado: To absorb large amounts of damage to protect allies in the game, or to withstand a difficult situation in real life.
geek.exemplo_correto: I'm going as a heavy warrior this match to tank the boss's attacks.
exemplos_incorretos: I tanked the car into the tight parking spot.
He's the long-range shooter, his role is to tank in the backline.
I tanked a health potion to recover my character's points.

Attacking enemies from a distance without taking direct hits.
Consuming edible items from the inventory.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a strategic role within the game (absorbing damage), without judgment about the player.

geek.significado: A temporary negative effect applied to a character, such as reduced speed, defense or causing poisoning.
geek.exemplo_correto: The boss put a slow debuff on me and I couldn't dodge the attack.
exemplos_incorretos: I drank a debuff potion to increase my damage by 100%.
The debuff restored all my ally's health in combat.
I swapped the debuff on the computer to make the system faster.
significados_incorretos: A beneficial effect that multiplies the character's strength.
An ability focused on health regeneration and healing.
A data processor used to speed up systems.
geek.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes a harmful effect that weakens the character.

geek.significado: A work of fiction (series, movie or game) derived from another existing one, focusing on secondary characters or elements.
geek.exemplo_correto: The series 'Better Call Saul' is a successful spin-off of the 'Breaking Bad' universe.
exemplos_incorretos: The car's spin-off broke down during the turn on the track.

significados_incorretos: A mechanical device found on automobile axles.
A main sequel that keeps the same narrative line and protagonist.
A brand of imported food products.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a type of derivative production, without judgment about its quality.

geek.significado: A narrative device in which a story ends at a moment of extreme suspense, without immediate resolution.
geek.exemplo_correto: The season's last episode ended on a shocking cliffhanger with the hero's fate uncertain.
exemplos_incorretos: I used a cliffhanger to hang the picture on the bedroom wall.

The cliffhanger is the actor who does the dangerous stunt scenes.
significados_incorretos: A metal bracket used to mount decorative objects.
A definitive ending to a plot, leaving no open questions.
A professional specialized in stunt work in productions.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a common narrative device, without specific emotional weight.

geek.significado: A fictional story created by fans using characters and universes from existing works created by other authors.

exemplos_incorretos: I bought the official fanfic book written and published by the original author.

A big-budget film adaptation produced by studios.
Adhesive material used in model aircraft building.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a common creative practice among fans, without judgment about who produces it.

geek.significado: The collection of stories, legends, history and world details in which a game, book or series takes place.

An artisanal baking unit of measurement.
An interface command that skips narrative sequences.

geek.significado: A game genre that uses random draw mechanics similar to capsule machines to obtain new characters or items.

significados_incorretos: A wooden structure applied to window frames.
A direct store system where there are no random elements.
A typical dish of Asian cuisine.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a luck-based game genre, with no value judgment implied by the term itself.

geek.significado: Acronym for 'Random Number Generator'. Used by players to refer to the luck factor or probability in the game.
geek.exemplo_correto: I lost the match because RNG didn't help and no rare item showed up for me.
exemplos_incorretos: My car's RNG broke down on the highway and the engine stopped.

A deterministic play style based purely on skill with no luck.
A cabling standard for local data networks.
geek.impacto_motivo: Depends on context because it can be used to celebrate a lucky result or to complain about bad luck, depending on the situation.

geek.significado: A crowd-control effect that leaves the character stunned and temporarily unable to move or perform actions.
geek.exemplo_correto: I took a stun from the enemy mage and stood still, unable to attack for two seconds.

The stun increased my ally's health during the battle.

A mechanic responsible for healing hit points.
A garment made for cold days.

geek.significado: Short for 'Most Effective Tactic Available'. Refers to the most efficient and strongest strategies, characters and team compositions at the current point in the game.

I picked the worst character in the game because he's the most meta of all.

A financial record of personal expenses.
geek.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it is a technical competitive term used to indicate efficient strategies, with no emotional weight.

geek.significado: A general term used in games to designate any generic creature or monster controlled by artificial intelligence.
